items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: He taught a little Alcorn, you know, Alvin. Alvin? That's his teacher, yeah.

ctx.x: Do you remember any other good trumpet men around that time? No.

Particular good? Well George McCullum, he was a very nice trumpet man too. You ever read in May? Yes, very good. He taught a little Alcorn, you know, Alvin. Alvin? That's his teacher, yeah. I think they were cousins. I don't know whether they were related or not, but I know he taught him. He's very good. He played a lot in the Excelsior Band, you know.
